copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要撰写并发布具有专业杂志风格的长篇文章。
copy.tagline_en: Generate long-form content with magazine-style layout
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to write and publish long articles with professional magazine styling.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会生成至少 600 字的杂志风格长文章，包含标题、作者署名、正文、图片说明、引用、作者简介和相关文章推荐。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 写一篇字数不少于 600 字的博客或长文章时触发。

say.text: 写一篇 800 字的博客文章，介绍如何在家种植蔬菜。
say.note: 会生成带标题、作者、正文等完整排版的长文。

say.text: 写一篇关于人工智能伦理的深度长文，附上几个案例。
say.note: 会包含 pull quote 和 figures。

howto.what_en: Claude will produce a magazine-style long-form article (≥600 words) with a masthead, hero section, body text, figures, pull quotes, author bio, and related posts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to write a blog post or long article of at least 600 words.

say_en.text: Write an 800-word blog post about growing vegetables at home.
say_en.note: Generates a full layout with title, author, body etc.

say_en.text: Write a deep article on AI ethics with a few case studies.
say_en.note: Will include pull quotes and figures.
